descriptions.zh: 用于将 PRD、用户故事或功能切片转成带稳定编号的 Given/When/Then 产品验收场景、边界、错误恢复和非功能通过条件。
descriptions.en: Use to turn a PRD, user story, or feature slice into stable-ID Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios, boundaries, recovery behavior, and non-functional pass/fail conditions.

routing.applicable_domain: product-level acceptance behavior for a specific story, feature slice, or user workflow
negative_examples: write a full engineering test suite or automation code
discover an undefined product direction or write a complete PRD
prerequisites: a story, PRD section, feature slice, or behavior description exists
the user-visible scope is specific enough to describe observable outcomes
